questions.calculus-section-9-3-4-project-applied-p: Horizontal sections of the radius2m sphere have areaπ(4h−h²). Half full meansh(0)=2m. Divide volume outflow through areaπ(0.01)² by this section, and integrate dt=(4h−h²)dh/[0.0001√(20h)] from0 to2.
